items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: And the more I hear him on recordings and tape I remember what he did.

ctx.x: The first jazz festival I went to was Dixieland at Disneyland, in 1964, and Pollock had a band there. And through suppressed memory, now I remember what he sounded like. At the time it was too much for me to absorb but thinking back on it I’m remembering the details of what he played. And the more I hear him on recordings and tape I remember what he did.
Some of those guys didn’t even — they had a different way of setting up their drums, didn’t they?
